newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela sets 70 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela sets 70 bln bolivar TEM bill auction.

text.p: Venezuela's Central Bank announced for Wednesday morning a 70-billion-bolivar auction of 180-, 269- and 358-day "monetary stabilization," or TEM, bills at nominal interest rates of up to 15.77 percent.

The bank said it would offer 50 billion bolivars worth of 180-day bills with a nominal interest rate of 15.20 percent, 10 billion bolivars of 269-day bills at 15.48 percent and 10 billion bolivars of 358-day bills at 15.77 percent.
At its auction last week the central bank sold 60 billion bolivars worth of 180-, 269- and 358-day bills with yields of 15.20 percent, 16.67 percent and 17.87 percent respectively.
